## PREFACE

This Lawyer Statistical Report covers the United States lawyer population as of the year 2005. It 
is the thirteenth Lawyer Statistical Report published by the American Bar Foundation since 1956. Like all 
previous reports, the statistics presented in this report were derived from baseline information provided 
by the publishers of the Martindale-Hubbell Law Directory. The American Bar Foundation is indebted to 
them for their long-standing commitment and invaluable contributions over time to publication of this 
and all earlier reports. 
This version of the Lawyer Statistical Report contains national and state level information on the 
demographics of lawyers. Updates on future Lawyer Statistical Report publications will be available on 
the American Bar Foundation website (www.AmericanBarFoundation.org). 
This report was prepared by Clara N. Carson of the American Bar Foundation. As with many 
previous reports, she was assisted substantially by Barbara A. Curran, Research Professor Emeritus at 
the American Bar Foundation, who passed away while this report was being prepared. 
Final formatting for the report was conducted by Jeeyoon Park, Research Analyst, at the 
American Bar Foundation, with assistance from Ahsin Azim. 
We are very grateful for the hard work and dedication that made this report possible. 

Robert L. Nelson Director, American Bar Foundation
